_comment: Example external vulnerability feed for qnginxscanner. Load with --vuln-feed <file-or-url> (repeatable) or list it under vuln_feeds: in the config file. Entries under 'nginx' are APPENDED to the built-in catalogue (the nginx.org advisory list). The IDs below are fake and every range sits on a fictional 99.x release line, so loading this file never changes the result of a real scan. Matching rules: a version matches an entry when ANY 'affected' range matches, unless it is on the same major.minor as a 'fixed_in' release and at or above it (that is how a stable-branch backport is expressed). Within one range every populated bound must hold: 'branch' pins a major.minor; 'introduced' is an inclusive lower bound; 'last' is an inclusive upper bound; 'fixed' and 'lt' are exclusive upper bounds; 'eq' matches one exact version. 'prereqs' qualify a lead against what the scan observed: kind 'protocol' (want: http2 | http3 | mail), 'os' (want: windows), 'module' (want: a module name such as http_dav) or 'config' (cannot be observed remotely; shown as context). Two further optional top-level keys exist: 'supported' maps each maintained branch to 'mainline' or 'stable' and REPLACES the built-in set when present (built-in: {"1.31": "mainline", "1.30": "stable"}); 'latest' maps a branch to its newest release and overrides per branch.
